If you want to report this issue, copy its text from the options menu (the three dots in the top right corner) and post a report at one of the following links. 

If you are reporting a Termux app crash, include details about what you were doing when the crash occurred and how to reproduce it, if possible. 

If you are posting a report on GitHub, post it in the repository the report relates to. Issues opened or emails sent with **partial screenshots** instead of the copied text or a file of this report **will likely be closed or deleted automatically**. You may optionally remove any device-specific information that you consider private, do not want to share, or that is not relevant to the issue. 

We do not provide support for hacking-related tools or scripts. Any questions about them by email, on GitHub or other official community forums for termux **will likely be closed or deleted automatically** and may even result in a **temporary or permanent suspension**. See %1$s/wiki/Hacking for more details.

The %1$s app cannot access the $PREFIX directory of the &TERMUX_APP_NAME; app. This may be because you have not installed or set up the &TERMUX_APP_NAME; app, or because the &TERMUX_APP_NAME; app and the %1$s app have different APK signatures since you installed both apps from different sources. It may also be because the &TERMUX_APP_NAME; $PREFIX directory \"&TERMUX_PREFIX_DIR_PATH;\" does not exist or does not have read, write, and execute permissions.
